questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Central African Republic?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Central African Republic article.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Central African Republic?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Central African Republic on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the Central African Republic article.

questions.proof: It is bordered by the countries of Cameroon, Chad, Sudan, South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Republic of the Congo.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Central African Republic?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Background” part of the Central African Republic article.

questions.proof: The main language is French but some people speak the national language of Sango.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “It is about the size of _____, and is somewhat smaller than the US state of Texas.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “size”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Central African Republic article, under the heading “Geography”.

questions.proof: It is about the size of Ukraine, and is somewhat smaller than the US state of Texas.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “In April _____, the country made bitcoin a legal tender, becoming the second country in the world to adopt the cryptocurrency.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twenty-first century.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Central African Republic article, under the heading “Background”.

questions.proof: In April 2022, the country made bitcoin a legal tender, becoming the second country in the world to adopt the cryptocurrency.

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia: Central African Republic
